claimShares(uint256,(bytes32,bytes32[],u.details: Phase1 price discovery: agent gets yesShares + noShares based on consensus proximity

params.creatorOffer: Extra USDC held as reward, distributed to CRE forwarder after Phase 1 reveal
params.question: The question to predict
params.schemaJson: Full resolution schema as JSON string (stored onchain)
params.ticketCost: Cost per ticket in USDC (6 decimals)
params.tradingDuration: Duration of trading phase in seconds

returns.marketId: The ID of the created market

executeOrderbookTrade(uint256,address,ad.details: Only callable by the orderbook. Transfers shares between maker and taker.

params.makerSellsYes: True if maker sells YES for NO
params.taker: Agent buying shares (pays the other outcome)
params.takerPaysAmount: Amount of the other outcome taker pays

onReport(bytes,bytes).details: Decodes report: selector 0 = phase1 (reveal), selector 1 = phase2 (resolve). Forwarder passes (metadata, report); we use only report.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

requestInfoReveal(uint256).details: Can be called by anyone or by Automation. Emits event for CRE to process.

requestResolution(uint256).details: Can be called by anyone or by Automation. Emits event for CRE to process.

supportsInterface(bytes4).details: Returns true if this contract implements the interface defined by `interfaceId`. See the corresponding https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-165#how-interfaces-are-identified[ERC section] to learn more about how these ids are created. This function call must use less than 30 000 gas.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

claimShares(uint256,(bytes32,bytes32[],u.notice: Claim initial shares via merkle proof

createMarket(string,string,uint256,uint2.notice: Create a new prediction market (USDC only)

executeOrderbookTrade(uint256,address,ad.notice: Execute a P2P trade from the orderbook (YES <-> NO shares only)

onReport(bytes,bytes).notice: Handles incoming keystone reports from the Forwarder.

requestInfoReveal(uint256).notice: Request info phase reveal after drand round is reached

requestResolution(uint256).notice: Request market resolution after trading period ends

revealInfoPhase(uint256,bytes32,uint8,ui.notice: Reveal info phase after drand round
